name: RAG and LLM app with evals and guardrails
summary: An assistant that answers from your own documents: ingestion and chunking, embeddings in pgvector (Qdrant is the swap), an agent graph that retrieves and cites, evaluations that run in CI, and guardrails on input and output.

fitsWhen.says: an app built on a language model
it needs AI answers or semantic search
the team writes Python or TypeScript

avoidWhen.says: data may not leave your servers unless a local model is used
per-token model costs are a problem

frontend.why: Streams answers token by token and shows citations.

backend.why: Python has the widest choice of retrieval, evaluation and model libraries.

ai-ml.why: Retrieval, tool calls and human review as an explicit graph with checkpoints.

database.why: Vectors next to the rows they describe, with SQL filters for permissions.

queue.why: Ingestion and re-embedding run in the background.

auth.why: Answers only draw on documents the person may read.

observability.why: Every model call traced with tokens, latency and cost.

testing.why: Faithfulness and relevance scored on a fixed question set in CI.

infra.why: API, worker, Postgres and (optionally) a local model server.

ci-cd.why: Unit tests, evals on a fixed set, images.

hosting.why: Containers; models through a provider API or vLLM/Ollama on your own GPU.

services.name: web
responsibilities: Chat UI with streaming and citations

services.name: llm
responsibilities: One interface to hosted and local models

dataStores.name: db
dataStores.purpose: Documents, chunks, embeddings and permissions in Postgres

environments.hosting: The hosted model with a small budget

environments.name: prod
environments.hosting: Hosted model with budgets, fallbacks and evals gating releases

stages.name: deploy
stages.does: Staging on main, prod on tags

notes: Embedding model and dimension recorded with every chunk
Thumbs up/down stored with the trace

security.auth: Retrieval filters by the person's permissions before the model sees a chunk
security.secrets: Provider keys only on the server
notes: Treat retrieved text as data, not instructions (prompt injection, OWASP LLM01)
Guardrails on output: no secrets, no personal data from other users
Log prompts with care: they contain user data

adrs.title: Vectors in Postgres
adrs.decision: Embeddings live in pgvector beside the documents.
adrs.why: Permission filters and joins in SQL; one database to back up.

adrs.title: Evals gate releases
adrs.decision: A fixed question set is scored in CI.
adrs.why: Model and prompt changes regress silently otherwise.
